statements.text: The shop consists of services, a datastore, a deployment target and an external provider.
Orders service, Payments service and Web shop are modules. Orders database stores data.
Orders API is provided by Orders service and consumed by Web shop. Stripe API is external.
Order is stored in Orders database and holds the fields an order needs.
The shop has Place order, Order history export, Card payment, Checkout and nested features.
Requirements name behaviour, data, integration, business rules and cross-area dependencies.
Checkout responds quickly and all services run in the EU region.
Stripe limits retries. Gift cards are out of scope for this release.
